test_title: PYST 5: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following regional film industries is based in Chennai and produces movies in the Tamil language?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kollywood**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kollywood** is the **film industry based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu**, and it primarily produces films in the **Tamil language**. The name "Kollywood" is derived from Kodambakkam, a neighborhood in Chennai, which is the hub of Tamil cinema.
 
• Tamil cinema is one of the largest film industries in India, known for its rich history, cultural contributions, and technological advancements in filmmaking.
 
• Kollywood has produced numerous critically acclaimed films, including **Enthiran (Robot)**, **Baasha**, and **Kaala**, which have been appreciated both nationally and internationally. *Hence, Kollywood is the correct answer.*
 
• The industry features renowned actors, directors, and musicians like **Rajinikanth**, **Kamal Haasan**, **Mani Ratnam**, and **A.R. Rahman**, who have contributed significantly to the global film scene.
 
• Chennai is the center of Tamil cinema, with major studios and production houses located in the city. It is often referred to as the **Hollywood of South India** due to its influence on Indian cinema. *Hence, Kollywood is the correct answer.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bollywood:**

 
 
• **Bollywood** is the **Hindi-language film industry** based in **Mumbai, Maharashtra**. It is the largest film industry in India in terms of revenue and production.
 
• Bollywood is known for its colorful musicals, dance sequences, and drama, with globally popular films like **Dangal**, **Sholay**, and **3 Idiots**.
 
 
 
• **Mollywood:**
 
 
• **Mollywood** refers to the **Malayalam film industry**, based in **Kerala**. It is known for realistic storytelling and high-quality cinematography.
 
• Popular films include **Drishyam**, **Kumbalangi Nights**, and **Premam**.
 
 
 
• **Tollywood:**
 
 
• **Tollywood** refers to the **Telugu-language film industry**, based in **Hyderabad, Telangana**.
 
• It has produced blockbuster films like **Baahubali** and **RRR**, which gained international recognition.
 
 
 
• **History of Tamil Cinema:**
 
 
• Tamil cinema started in the early **20th century**. **Kalidas (1931)** was the first Tamil talkie film.
 
• It has evolved technologically, with Tamil filmmakers pioneering new innovations in **special effects, cinematography, and storytelling**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Cultural Impact:**

 
 
• Kollywood has a significant impact on Tamil culture and identity, with films often reflecting social issues, traditions, and politics.
 
• The industry has influenced other regional cinemas and contributed to the global recognition of Indian cinema.
 
 
 
• **Key Contributions:**
 
 
• Kollywood introduced **technology-driven movies** like **Enthiran** and **2.0**, which showcased advanced special effects.
 
• The industry continues to produce films that are celebrated for their innovative themes and cultural relevance.
